# Auryx

> MD-led precision longevity clinic offering medically supervised peptide therapy protocols nationwide via telemedicine.

Auryx (also styled AURYX) provides physician-guided peptide protocols, educational resources, and research-grade compounds with third-party testing and certificates of analysis.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.auryxlife.com/): Brand overview and protocol collections
- [Shop](https://www.auryxlife.com/shop): Full peptide catalog
- [Learn](https://www.auryxlife.com/learn): Peptide therapy education and compound guides
- [Journal / Blog](https://www.auryxlife.com/blog): Physician-authored articles on longevity and peptides
- [Our Method](https://www.auryxlife.com/our-method): Clinical methodology
- [About](https://www.auryxlife.com/about): Physician leadership, medical review process, and quality standards
- [Contact](https://www.auryxlife.com/contact): Clinic email and consultation intake
- [Sources](https://www.auryxlife.com/sources): Citations behind educational claims
- [Peptide Therapy in New York](https://www.auryxlife.com/peptide-therapy-new-york): Telehealth peptide therapy for New York residents
- [Protocol Finder](https://www.auryxlife.com/protocol-finder): Guided recommendation flow
- [Terms](https://www.auryxlife.com/terms)
- [Privacy](https://www.auryxlife.com/privacy)
